  SELECT
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE ss_quantity BETWEEN 1 AND 20) AS cnt_1_20,
    avg(ss_ext_tax) FILTER (WHERE ss_quantity BETWEEN 1 AND 20) AS avg_ext_tax_1_20,
    avg(ss_net_paid_inc_tax) FILTER (WHERE ss_quantity BETWEEN 1 AND 20) AS avg_net_paid_inc_tax_1_20,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE ss_quantity BETWEEN 21 AND 40) AS cnt_21_40,
    avg(ss_ext_tax) FILTER (WHERE ss_quantity BETWEEN 21 AND 40) AS avg_ext_tax_21_40,
    avg(ss_net_paid_inc_tax) FILTER (WHERE ss_quantity BETWEEN 21 AND 40) AS avg_net_paid_inc_tax_21_40,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE ss_quantity BETWEEN 41 AND 60) AS cnt_41_60,
    avg(ss_ext_tax) FILTER (WHERE ss_quantity BETWEEN 41 AND 60) AS avg_ext_tax_41_60,
    avg(ss_net_paid_inc_tax) FILTER (WHERE ss_quantity BETWEEN 41 AND 60) AS avg_net_paid_inc_tax_41_60,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE ss_quantity BETWEEN 61 AND 80) AS cnt_61_80,
    avg(ss_ext_tax) FILTER (WHERE ss_quantity BETWEEN 61 AND 80) AS avg_ext_tax_61_80,
    avg(ss_net_paid_inc_tax) FILTER (WHERE ss_quantity BETWEEN 61 AND 80) AS avg_net_paid_inc_tax_61_80,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE ss_quantity BETWEEN 81 AND 100) AS cnt_81_100,
    avg(ss_ext_tax) FILTER (WHERE ss_quantity BETWEEN 81 AND 100) AS avg_ext_tax_81_100,
    avg(ss_net_paid_inc_tax) FILTER (WHERE ss_quantity BETWEEN 81 AND 100) AS avg_net_paid_inc_tax_81_100
  FROM store_sales
)
SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN agg.cnt_1_20 > 1071 THEN agg.avg_ext_tax_1_20
    ELSE agg.avg_net_paid_inc_tax_1_20
  END AS bucket1,
  CASE
    WHEN agg.cnt_21_40 > 39161 THEN agg.avg_ext_tax_21_40
    ELSE agg.avg_net_paid_inc_tax_21_40
  END AS bucket2,
  CASE
    WHEN agg.cnt_41_60 > 29434 THEN agg.avg_ext_tax_41_60
    ELSE agg.avg_net_paid_inc_tax_41_60
  END AS bucket3,
  CASE
    WHEN agg.cnt_61_80 > 6568 THEN agg.avg_ext_tax_61_80
    ELSE agg.avg_net_paid_inc_tax_61_80
  END AS bucket4,
  CASE
    WHEN agg.cnt_81_100 > 21216 THEN agg.avg_ext_tax_81_100
    ELSE agg.avg_net_paid_inc_tax_81_100

JOIN sales_agg AS agg ON reason.r_reason_sk = 1
